messages:
Elaine S: Heads up — we're rolling a small ratecard patch (v2.3.1) that tweaks POC commit discounts and clarifies grandfathering. See https://redwood.docs/ratecard/v2.3.1
Samir K: Nice. Does this change affect APAC surcharges or just the commit %s?
Marta (Deal Desk): Short answer: commit tiers only. APAC surcharge unchanged. We'll update CPQ mapping tonight.
Samir K: OK. Any guidance for deals already in 'negotiation' stage? Some AEs have signed LOIs pending SOW.
Elaine S: If LOI signed before 2026-03-01 -> grandfather to old slab. New commits after that date pick v2.3.1. We added a 14-day grace window for paperwork.
Raj P: Legal flag — special-term exceptions (custom usage caps) still require LL review. For any deviations, drop a note to #deal-exceptions with the doc link.
Marta (Deal Desk): We'll add two new CPQ tags: `ratecard-v2-3-1` and `grandfather-grace`. Pricebot will auto-apply for eligible quotes.
pricebot: INFO: Applied tag `ratecard-v2-3-1` to quote Q-38902 (AE: @jakob). See /pricing/quotes/Q-38902
Linda M: Ops note: rollout is staged — hosted customers first, then dedicated next week. For urgent enterprise closes, escalate to me with a CC to @samir.
Samir K: One more Q — any change to commit backfill rules? We have a customer wanting credit for prior usage.
Elaine S: Backfill policy unchanged. We will not retroactively apply new lower tiers for past tokens. Exceptions possible via deal-exceptions review.
Marta (Deal Desk): CPQ patch scheduled 03:15 UTC tonight. Expect small window where quote calculations show both rates — doc explains it.
Raj P: I'll prep a short blurb for legal signoff flow and templates.
Linda M: Thx team. I'll post a short broadcast to #sales with the highlights + link to the full kb. :thumbsup:
Elaine S: Thanks — collecting questions here; if AEs hit blockers, tag `ratecard-v2-3-1` and we'll triage.
Samir K: :thumbsup:
Marta (Deal Desk): FYI — updated example JSON for the billing team:
```
{"commit_tier":"500k","discount_pct":"8%","tag":"ratecard-v2-3-1"}
```
Raj P: Noted.
pricebot: REMINDER: Deal desk hours extended tonight until 2am UTC to process CPQ fixes.
Elaine S: Closing thread — will keep a running changelog in the KB. Link: https://redwood.docs/ratecard/v2.3.1
